g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-412 Bench spindle capper (built in house) · rev B
No product contact (caps on): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: Bench spindle capper P1-412, built in house, 1 off, rev B
Lever-fed spinning chuck on a linear rail; slip clutch sets the cap torque; V-nest with a toggle clamp; 120 V cord and plug
screw caps on shakers (53 mm cap, 1.6 N·m) and jars (89 mm cap, 2.5 N·m) after the filler P1-401
1/8 HP PMDC gearmotor 190 rpm, KB SCR drive, slip clutch 0.5-5 N·m, floating chuck 12 mm
carriage on MGN15 rail, gas spring return, lever 400 long (34 N at the knob), stop rod + flip block
UHMW V-block in 2 positions (S / J), push-pull toggle clamp with a V pad
E-stop, ON/OFF, pilot, speed pot; limit switch inhibits the chuck with the carriage up
on the bench TBL-1 (top 914 AFF), 4 x M8; footprint 400 x 350; height 718 + lever
14 per min one operator (filler 12 shakers / 8 jars per min)
full shop set: rail carriage, slip clutch torque, floating chuck, V-nest clamp, standing controls box at the front-left
SECTION A-A ON THE SPINDLE, DETAILS: NEST, STOP, PIVOT
1. Units mm [in]. Third-angle projection. Tolerances in the title block unless noted. Weld symbols AWS A2.4; welding to AWS D1.6.
2. No product contact with the cap on; containers touch only UHMW (FDA). Finish #4 or bead blast, passivated ASTM A967.
3. Cut files (DXF) in dxf/ in mm and inch; 3D: cad/ (STEP per part, P1-412-ASM.step/.glb); generator: design.py, model.py, sh_*.py.
4. Bought parts marked 'confirm' must be checked against the supplier drawing before the matching made part is cut (motor face, clutch bores, rail holes).
5. Release for build: drawings checked, ITP P1-412-900 attached to the traveler, materials certified.
